Shanghai Municipal Police.

C. : D.
I. O. REG
No. 591
Date 14-9-16

Sinsa Station.
14th September. 1916

REPORT ON A supposed meeting at 10 Bubbling Well
Road.

Made by D.J.Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by Inspector King.

Sir:
The Pao Yuen (葆元) Hospital is situated at 10 Bubbling
Well Road where people wishing to rid themselves of the opium
habit are treated by a chinese Doctor named Daung Yao Ching
(唐堯) who according to our information went to Peking
about a month ago with a view of getting a position under the
present Government and has not up to the present returned.
His place at the Hospital having been taken by one Wong Zu
Yuen (王士元) who about a week ago was approached by two revo-
lutionaries Nien Yuen Doh (任接道) and Yih Bien Sing (葉天新)
living in Syc Tuh Lee (修德里) No. unknown on the French side
of Avenue Edward VII. who asked Dr. Wong that they be allowed
to have an office there at No. 10 Bubbling Well Road and
further that they be permitted to invite their Rebel followers
to this address with a view of discussing on Monday last where
the remains of the late Chueh Ling Hsu (闕林蘇) who died in
what formerly was the Railway Hospital in Range Road as well as
the body Daung Chi Sing (唐繼星) who is said to have been
executed at Peking may be buried.

It is said that Dr. Wong in the absence of the tenant
over
refused permission and that no meeting was held.

Yours Obediently,
Maurice Fitzgibbon.
Det. Inspr.

The Chief Detective Inspector.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

C. : D.
I. O. REG
第 591 号
日期 16-9-14

新闸捕房。
1916年9月14日。

关于静安寺路10号一处疑似集会的报告。

由 D.J. Fitzgibbon 撰写。经金巡官（Inspector King）转呈。

先生：
葆元医院位于静安寺路10号，该院由一名名为唐堯（Daung Yao Ching）的中医负责治疗希望戒除鸦片瘾的人士。据我方情报，唐氏约于一个月前前往北京，意图在现政府中谋得一职，迄今未归。其在医院的职位已由王士元（Wong Zu Yuen）接替。约一周前，两名居住在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）法租界一侧修德里（Syc Tuh Lee）某号（门牌不详）的革命党人任接道（Nien Yuen Doh）和葉天新（Yih Bien Sing）接触了王医生，请求允许他们在静安寺路10号设立办事处，并进一步请求允许他们邀请其反叛追随者到此地址，以便在上周一讨论已故闕林蘇（Chueh Ling Hsu）的遗骸安葬事宜。闕氏死于原兰路（Range Road）铁路医院。此外，还讨论了据称在北京被处决的唐繼星（Daung Chi Sing）的遗体安葬问题。

据悉，王医生因租户不在而拒绝了上述请求，因此并未举行集会。

此致，
敬礼
莫里斯·菲茨吉本（Maurice Fitzgibbon）。
侦探巡长。

首席侦探巡长。

pages.en:
Commercial News.
12-9-16.
10 B:Well Rd.
Sooja District.

On Monday afternoon thirty rebels held a meeting in the Pao Yuen 葆元 Hospital on Bubbling Well Road discussing the place wherein the remain of the late Chueh Ling Hsu 闕麟書 who was a noted rebel and died in the Sasaki Hospital on the 3rd inst., is to be buried. Afterwards they decided that the Government be approached to give a piece of land near the West Lake, in Hangchow, on which to build the late Mr. Chueh's tomb. They will also tender a memorial service in honour of their deceased associate. One Nyoh Tien Lai 葉天 was selected to discuss these matters with Tuchun Lu of Chekiang. The venue of the late Chueh's memorial service will be at Chang Su-ho's Garden. During the meeting one Chang Kung Cheng 張拱辰 suggested that the proposed memorial service should not only be for Chueh but for Daung Chi Sin 唐繼星 also as Daung was an old associate of Chueh. This was approved.

(Daung was recently abducted from the Settlement and shot in Peking by the late Yuan Shih Kai's Government.

(印：FS Sullivan / 13 SEP 1916 / MA)
pages.zh:
《商业新闻》。
1916年9月12日。
静安寺路10号。
苏州河以南地区。

周一下午，三十名反叛分子在静安寺路的葆元医院举行集会，讨论著名反叛分子闕麟書（Chueh Ling Hsu）遗骸的安葬地点。闕氏于本月3日死于佐佐木医院（Sasaki Hospital）。会后，他们决定向政府申请在杭州西湖附近拨给一块土地，用于修建闕先生的墓冢。他们还将举行追悼会，以纪念其逝去的同志。会议选定葉天（Nyoh Tien Lai）负责与浙江督军卢永祥就此事进行商谈。闕氏追悼会的地点定在张叔和（Chang Su-ho）的花园。会议期间，张拱辰（Chang Kung Cheng）建议，拟议中的追悼会不仅应针对闕氏，也应包括唐繼星（Daung Chi Sin），因为唐氏是闕氏的老同志。该建议获得通过。

（唐氏近期从租界被绑架，并被前袁世凯政府在北京枪决。）

（印章：FS Sullivan / 1916年9月13日 / MA）
